get_unprobed.grants_note: People sign in at this front door through another issuer than Canyon's, so an app shared with a person won't let them in. Sharing with a group or with everyone still does.
get_unprobed.probe_note: Not checked on this cluster: Canyon builds nothing here until a save finds NetworkPolicy enforced, so no deploy goes through, whoever runs the apps. This cluster does not enforce NetworkPolicy, so an app's port could be reached without signing in. Turn enforcement on (on EKS: enableNetworkPolicy "true" and NETWORK_POLICY_ENFORCING_MODE "strict" in the vpc-cni add-on) and save again.
